# Data Cleaning

This file prepares the analytical dataset used in the thesis.

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
```

## Load data

```{r}
df <- read.csv("data/processed/student_politics_final.csv")
```

## Clean variables

```{r}
df_clean <- df %>%
  mutate(
    parliamentarian = as.numeric(parliamentarian),
    minister = as.numeric(minister),
    ran_for_council = as.numeric(ran_for_council),
    student_council = as.numeric(student_council),
    university_council = as.numeric(university_council),
    gender = factor(gender),
    cohort = factor(cohort),
    student_association = factor(student_association)
  )
```

## Restrict analytical sample

```{r}
df_analysis <- df_clean %>%
  filter(ran_for_council == 1)
```

## Change names of variables for simplicity

```{r}
names(df)[names(df) == "parliamentarian"] <- "MP"
names(df)[names(df) == "student_association"] <- "association"
names(df)[names(df) == "student_year_decade"] <- "student_year_decade"
```

# Vaka as reference group

```{r}
df$association <- as.factor(df$association)
df$association <- relevel(df$association, ref = "Vaka")
```
